---
title: "X_spiracleAnalysis"
output: html_document
---

# Load libraries

```{r}
# Load tidyverse
library(tidyverse)

# Load broom
library(broom)

# Load patchwork for plotting
library(patchwork)
```

# Load data

```{r}
# Load csv
rayData <- read.csv("Data/Data_Tidy/allMuseumRayData.csv")
```

# Prepare data for analysis

```{r}
logData <- rayData %>%
  mutate(logSA = log10(SpiracleArea),
         # Convert Spiracle Length (SPL) to cm and log10
         SPL_cm = SpiracleLength / 10,
         logSPL = log10(SPL_cm)) %>%
  # Drop rows with NAs
  drop_na(logSA, logSPL) %>%
  # Remove species with less than 4 individuals
  group_by(Genus_species) %>%
  filter(n() > 3) %>%
  ungroup()
```

# Run linear model

```{r}
# Run linear model
model <- lm(logSA ~  logSPL * Genus_species, data = logData)
# Show model summary
summary(model)

# Convert summary to a df
model_sum <- tidy(model)
# Export to csv
write.csv(model_sum, file = "Results/Tables/SPL_SA.csv", 
          row.names = FALSE)
```

# Generate predicted data

```{r}
# Generate predicted data for smooth lines
spiraclePred <- logData %>%
  group_by(Genus_species) %>%
  reframe(logSPL = seq(min(logSPL), max(logSPL), length.out = 100))
# Add model predicted values to data frame
spiraclePred$predictedSA <- predict(model, newdata = spiraclePred)
```

# Plot

```{r}
plot <- ggplot(data = logData, aes(x = logSPL, y = logSA)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) 10^x) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(y) 10^y) +
  labs(x = "Spiracle Length (cm)",
       y = expression("Spiracle Surface Area ( " * cm^2 * ")")) +
  theme_classic()

plot

ggsave("Results/Figures/SPL_SA.png", plot,
       width = 12, height = 9)
```
